high_level_description: This image depicts the famous Lion Monument (Löwendenkmal) located in Lucerne, Switzerland. The monument is carved into a large rock face and features a detailed sculpture of a lion lying down, appearing to be asleep or resting. The lion's head rests on its front paws, and it is depicted with a fierce yet serene expression. Above the lion, there is an inscription in Latin that reads: "HELVETIORUM FIDEI AC VIRTUTI," which translates to "To the fidelity and valor of the Swiss." This inscription commemorates the Swiss Guards who were massacred by order of King Louis
